in_sanskrit.name: रुपराम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has incomparable beauty or form.

in_hindi.name: रुपराम
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिसका रूप अन्यथा के सबसे अनुपम है।

in_marathi.name: Ruparam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ruparam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit 'Rupa' meaning form and 'Rama' meaning joy. This name signifies the joy of possessing wealth and prosperity, akin to a precious jewel. It is a name for the fortunate and the blessed.
